Split a covariate into between-unit and within-unit components

decompose_covariate.Rd

Separates one or more continuous covariates into a between-unit part (the grouping-unit mean) and a within-unit part (the deviation from that mean). Entering both parts as predictors lets engines that support both strata adjust the between-unit and within-unit relationships separately. The within part is a genuine observation-level covariate suitable for [permanova_nested_covariate()]; the between part is a unit-level summary and must only be entered in an engine that assigns numeric terms to that level (for example [permanova_mixed_covariate()]).

Usage

decompose_covariate(
  data,
  covariate,
  by,
  center = TRUE,
  suffix = c("_between", "_within")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

covariate

Character vector of continuous covariate column names.

by

Character vector of grouping column name(s) defining the units; the between/within split is taken with respect to their combination.

center

Grand-centre the between-unit component (default `TRUE`) so it is a deviation from the overall mean. The within-unit component always has mean zero within every unit regardless of this setting.

suffix

Length-two character vector of column-name suffixes for the between and within parts.

Value

`data` with two added columns per covariate. With `center = FALSE` the between and within columns sum to the original covariate.

Examples

df <- data.frame(site = factor(rep(1:3, each = 4)), x = rnorm(12))
decompose_covariate(df, "x", by = "site")
#>    site            x  x_between   x_within
#> 1     1 -1.400043517 -0.5353601 -0.5031532
#> 2     1  0.255317055 -0.5353601  1.1522074
#> 3     1 -2.437263611 -0.5353601 -1.5403733
#> 4     1 -0.005571287 -0.5353601  0.8913191
#> 5     2  0.621552721  0.2867355  0.6963474
#> 6     2  1.148411606  0.2867355  1.2232063
#> 7     2 -1.821817661  0.2867355 -1.7470230
#> 8     2 -0.247325302  0.2867355 -0.1725306
#> 9     3 -0.244199607  0.2486246 -0.1312940
#> 10    3 -0.282705449  0.2486246 -0.1697998
#> 11    3 -0.553699384  0.2486246 -0.4407938
#> 12    3  0.628982042  0.2486246  0.7418876
